description: Hurricane Preparation and Recovery Commodity Guides is a web tool or resource listed in U.S. Climate Resilience Toolkit, a national climate-adaptation toolkit, published or maintained by USDA Southeast Climate Hub. Producers in the Southeast can access these guides to help prepare for and recover from the impacts of tropical storms and hurricanes. State Commodity Guides contain hurricane preparation and recovery guidance and resource links for the most economically important agricultural commodities in the region. Coverage: the Southeast. The toolkit lists hazards: Flooding – General, High Winds. Assets: Agriculture and Food Supply, Economy, Forestry, Natural Areas and Wildlife, Property, Water Infrastructure – Stormwater. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the toolkit page (no licence or terms statement seen). Caveats: this record was written from the toolkit page, which was read; the tool itself was not opened or run, its licence and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support climate-adaptation planning and exposure screening. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-us-climate-resilience-toolkit-catalogue.
